text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm... an Umamusume born as the daughter 
of an enka singer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And when we were still children— we made a 
promise.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
With Satono Diamond, who has become my 
very best friend, I made a super, super 
important promise.

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
A big race, huh. I see, so you want to run 
in them too, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run in it someday too. And make 
everyone smile just like Dad! Just like 
Dad does with his songs."

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dia-chan, why do you want to run in 
races?

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text:
You see... Dia wants to win a G1 race. 
Because I feel like that's what I was born 
to do.

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
I see! In that case, Dia-chan! Let's go to 
Tracen Academy together! And then we can 
run together, too!

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan...! Yeah, it's a promise. Let's 
run in the Classic Triple Crown together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right after my most important friend—I met 
the Umamusume I admire. Someone who made 
me think from the bottom of my heart, 'I 
want to be like her!'

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Tokai Teio! Tokai Teio conquers the 
Satsuki Sho! She puts her brilliant talent 
on full display!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Allllright, that's one crown down! I'll 
show you the invincible Teio legend 
starting right here!"

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Tokai... Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san, whom I look up to; Dia-chan, who 
runs alongside me. And... my respected 
father.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I'm truly blessed. Everyone I need to 
make my dream come true is right here 
around me. All the people I love. All 
that's left is—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—I just have to see it through! I'm going 
to become an Umamusume who makes everyone 
smile!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaaan! I'm so sorryyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, I can't believe it~. Being late 
on my very first day of the Twinkle 
Series...
choice_data_list:
Were you out "helping" someone somewhere 
again?

Were you out "helping" someone somewhere 
again?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! A station wagon had stalled on a 
hill, so I was helping push it from 
behind, and before I knew it~.

This Umamusume is Kitasan Black. She's the 
Umamusume I train.

A warm-hearted soul who can never leave 
someone in trouble behind. And her 
greatest strength is—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah! Here I go, slope rep number 3! 
Something like this is nothing, let's keep 
going--!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu*, thank you for your hard work!

Her strength is her sheer toughness, 
capable of enduring grueling training. 
Armed with this, her challenge in the 
Twinkle Series finally begins.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Kita-chan. You're already 
working super hard.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dia-chan! Yeah, of course. The moment 
I've been waiting for is finally here!

This Umamusume is Satono Diamond. She's 
Kitasan Black's childhood friend and the 
heiress to the massive Satono 
conglomerate.

Apparently, they made a promise when they 
were little to run the Classic Triple 
Crown together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they beat us to registering for 
the series. But...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'll catch up to you in no time. When I 
do, let's give it our all. As classmates."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I might be a step ahead in the debut 
race, but Dia-chan knows way more about 
race strategy and the like.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I still have so much to learn~. I need to 
become someone who can lead the way in 
front for Dia-chan, just like when we were 
little."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, Trainer! For our next 
session, let's do special training on the 
woodchip course! I can still keep going!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm gonna work you hard!
Yeah, I won't go easy on you.

text_block_list.text:
Honest, single-minded, and resilient. 
Though still unpolished, Kitasan Black 
harbors boundless potential.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I'm... not all that nimble. All I've got 
right now is my toughness... but my desire 
to make everyone smile won't lose to 
anyone!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Always stay on the offensive! Push 
forward, keep working hard, and give it 
everything until the very end!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's finally starting from here. My 
challenge for my dream! And—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'm going to run my absolute best 
on a huge stage! Along with Dia-chan and 
Teio-san!
